title: [応用] JOIN集計とHAVINGで活発な藩を探す
statement: 運営は2026年4月以降に3件以上のメッセージがある藩だけを表彰します。organizationsとmessagesをJOINし、藩名とmessage_countを集計してください。WHEREで期間を絞り、HAVINGで件数を絞り、件数降順・藩名昇順に並べます。
input: CREATE TABLE organizations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL); INSERT INTO organizations VALUES (1,'土佐藩'),(2,'薩摩藩'),(3,'長州藩'); INSERT INTO messages VALUES (1,1,'2026-04-01'),(2,1,'2026-04-02'),(3,1,'2026-04-03'),(4,1,'2026-03-01'),(5,2,'2026-04-01'),(6,2,'2026-04-02'),(7,3,'2026-04-01'),(8,3,'2026-04-02'),(9,3,'2026-04-03'),(10,3,'2026-04-04');
starterSql:
SELECT o.name, COUNT(*) AS message_count
FROM organizations o JOIN messages m ON m.organization_id=o.id
WHERE m.created_at >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY o.id, o.name
HAVING -- 件数条件
ORDER BY message_count DESC, o.name;
solutionSql: SELECT o.name, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM organizations o JOIN messages m ON m.organization_id=o.id WHERE m.created_at >= '2026-04-01' GROUP BY o.id,o.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY message_count DESC,o.name;
expectedCsv:
name,message_count
長州藩,4
土佐藩,3
